headline: Uncle Sam's 💸💰 $40TN Debt 💥🚨: Bond Yields 🏦📈 GOING BRRR 💨💦
text: Uncle Sam 🍔🇺🇸 just went FULL SEND 💨🚀 and hit that THICC $40.05TN national debt milestone 💸🍑 - DOUBLED in a DECADE like a crypto rug-pull 📉🐍! 2016 was only $20TN 💰🧓, now we're SLAYING the debt ceiling like it's a TikTok dance trend 🕺💃! Mohamed El-Erian 🧠💼 calling it YIELD CURVE CONTROL 🎮📉, but warns of COLLATERAL DAMAGE 💥🔨 like a Marvel movie plot! The DEBT CEILING is approaching faster than a speeding bullet 🚄💨 at $41.1TN, and consumers are getting SLAPPED with higher rates on everything from CARS 🚗💸 to CREDIT CARDS 💳😤! It's an ECONOMIC ORGY 💦📈 where everyone's borrowing like there's no TOMORROW 🌅💸!
